AnalyzeHoldingsIn.title: AnalyzeHoldingsIn
AnalyzeHoldingsIn.description: Holdings to analyze without saving them (the MCP analyze_portfolio tool).

ApiTokenCreated.title: ApiTokenCreated
ApiTokenCreated.description: The only response that carries the token itself; it can't be shown again.

Artifact.title: Artifact
Artifact.description: Chart or table payload the UI renders next to an answer (CH-06).

AuthConfigOut.title: AuthConfigOut
AuthConfigOut.description: Public sign-in options so the landing page shows the right button.

BenchmarkComparison.title: BenchmarkComparison
BenchmarkComparison.description: PF-05: today's holdings versus the benchmark over the same dates.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: One message in a conversation, as the chat UI renders it.

Citation.title: Citation
Citation.description: What the UI shows on a source card (CH-04).

CitationEvent.title: CitationEvent
CitationEvent.description: A source card; `number` matches the answer's [n] marker.

CsvImportOut.title: CsvImportOut
CsvImportOut.description: Parsed rows to review in the form before saving, plus per-row problems.

Diversification.title: Diversification
Diversification.description: Concentration-based score from 0 (one position) to 100 (broadly spread) (PF-03).

DoneEvent.title: DoneEvent
DoneEvent.description: The finished, compliance-checked message. The client should render this one.

ErrorEnvelope.title: ErrorEnvelope
ErrorEnvelope.description: Every error response uses this shape: {error: {code, message, retryable}}.

ErrorEvent.title: ErrorEvent
ErrorEvent.description: The turn failed; uses the same fields as the REST error envelope.

ExampleAllocation.title: ExampleAllocation
ExampleAllocation.description: A generic textbook mix for a risk profile, shown as education only (GL-04).

Freshness.title: Freshness
Freshness.description: Where a number came from and how fresh it is (MD-07). Shown as a badge in the UI.

GoalIn.title: GoalIn
GoalIn.description: GL-02. Without a risk profile the goal uses the user's own (moderate if unset).

ImageAttachment.title: ImageAttachment
ImageAttachment.description: A portfolio screenshot (CH-09). The route checks size and type; it is never stored.

Indicators.title: Indicators
Indicators.description:
Plain-language market insights for one symbol, computed from daily bars (MD-08).

Percent fields are percentages (1.5 means 1.5%).

KbSearchOut.title: KbSearchOut
KbSearchOut.description: Retrieved passages for a question (KB-05). Empty `results` means nothing relevant.

MarketOverviewResponse.title: MarketOverviewResponse
MarketOverviewResponse.description: Day 1: indices. Sector performance and movers arrive with the indicators service.

Observation.title: Observation
Observation.description: An educational learning point about the portfolio, never an instruction (PF-06).

PerformancePoint.title: PerformancePoint
PerformancePoint.description: Portfolio and benchmark on one date, both rebased to 100 at the start (PF-05).

ProjectionOut.title: ProjectionOut
ProjectionOut.description: Projection for given inputs (GL-03), plus the textbook mix for the profile (GL-04).

ReplaceEvent.title: ReplaceEvent
ReplaceEvent.description: Supersedes everything streamed so far (a compliance rewrite, a retried agent).

RiskAnswers.title: RiskAnswers
RiskAnswers.description: Question id -> chosen option id, for every question (GL-01).

RiskMetrics.title: RiskMetrics
RiskMetrics.description: PF-04. Volatility and drawdown come from today's holdings replayed over history.

RouteEvent.title: RouteEvent
RouteEvent.description: The router's plan: which agents will answer (CH-03 badges show from here).

SectorPerformance.title: SectorPerformance
SectorPerformance.description: A sector's day move, measured through its sector ETF (MD-08).

SymbolInfo.title: SymbolInfo
SymbolInfo.description: One entry in the symbol directory used for ticker search and validation (MD-09).

TokenEvent.title: TokenEvent
TokenEvent.description: Text to append to the answer.

TraceEvent.title: TraceEvent
TraceEvent.description:
One node's timing, LLM usage and tool calls for logs and the "How I answered" panel
(OR-08, INN-01). Built by `src.workflow.tracing.trace_step`.

TraceStepEvent.title: TraceStepEvent
TraceStepEvent.description: A workflow node finished: its timing, LLM usage and tool calls (OR-08).
